The notice of survey and summons and order shall be served in accordance with the New York state civil practice law and rules.
(Am. L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
